<html:fieldset id="emailE2eeKeyServers" data-category="panePrivacy">
      <html:legend data-l10n-id="email-e2ee-key-servers-legend"></html:legend>
      <html:p data-l10n-id="email-e2ee-key-servers-intro"></html:p>
      <html:hr />
      <html:p data-l10n-id="email-e2ee-key-servers-use-following"></html:p>
      <html:ul id="keyServerList" class="indent">
        <html:template id="keyServerListItem">
          <html:li>
            <html:label>
              <html:input type="checkbox" checked="checked"/>
              <html:span class="checkbox-label"></html:span>
            </html:label>
          </html:li>
        </html:template>
      </html:ul>
      <html:button id="keyServerAdd"
                   type="button"
                   data-l10n-id="email-e2ee-key-servers-add"
                   onclick="gPrivacyPane.addKeyServer();">
      </html:button>
      <html:button id="keyServerReset"
                   type="button"
                   data-l10n-id="email-e2ee-key-servers-reset"
                   onclick="gPrivacyPane.resetKeyServerList();">
     </html:button>
